description: This file defines a command handler class for creating payment types within the Fineract system. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and delegates creation logic to PaymentTypeWriteService.

classes.name: CreatePaymentTypeCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles creation commands for payment types, annotated with command type metadata.

methods.name: CreatePaymentTypeCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the PaymentTypeWriteService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Transactional method that processes the command to create a new payment type by delegating to the write service.
